messages:
Maya: Quick proposal for a compact onboarding/prioritization matrix and pin policy. Want fast feedback before I formalize an RFC. TL;DR: three lanes (Quickpass / Default / Lockdown), numeric prioritization score, deterministic pin TTLs.

Jorge: Summarize lanes?

Maya: Quickpass = low infra impact, public model, <=2pt eval variance, 2-4w. Default = full harness + staged canary, 8-12w. Lockdown = private/VPC or regulatory; KMS + audit required, 12+w, paid migration credits.

Sophia: How to score requests?

Maya: Proposal: score = round((impact*revenue_multiplier)/(infra_cost + stability_risk + kernel_flag)) with fields: impact 1-10, revenue_multiplier 1/3/5, infra_cost 0.1-10, stability_risk 0-10, kernel_flag 0 or 1.5. Sort descending.

Max: Defaults: revenue_multiplier 1=community,3=paying,5=enterprise. Include infra multipliers for kernel/quant/dedicated HW.

Eva: Need billing worked examples (finance will ask).

Maya: Will add. Canary defaults: cohort=min(0.5% tenant traffic,2k req/day), duration 48h gen/72h embed, auto-halt if p50>baseline+25ms OR errors +4% OR eval safety drop >2.5pts.

Sophia: Add hallucination probe threshold (<=1.4x baseline) and per-tenant anchor prompts (5-10) to catch customer-specific regressions.

Maya: Pin TTL tiers: 14d / 60d / 365d. Pins >60d require paid commitment or reserved capacity. Pin-exemptions allowed with legal+security signoff and capped.

Jorge: Who runs canary? Platform orchestrates, model owner supplies eval artifacts and signs off. rollout-bot posts status and auto-halts on triggers.

Max: Rollback choreography: stop canary -> route traffic to fallback variant -> notify customer -> open mitigation ticket; freeze model in catalog on full rollback.

Maya: Acceptance checklist (Default lane): eval <=2pt drop, hallucination <=1.4x, safety within -2.5pts; perf p50 <=+25ms, p95 <=+60ms; infra_cost_delta <=20% or infra signoff; monitoring anchors configured; staged rollout 1%->10%->50%->100% with 24h stable windows.

Eva: +1 but insist on billing examples.

Maya: I'll draft RFC + scoring sheet + billing worked examples and schedule a 45m sync. Please react here.

rollout-bot: Canary started for model "redwood-demo-x" on tenant "ACME", 850 req/day, duration=48h. Monitoring hooks active.
